dogecoin.text:
Hey @elonmusk I have an idea. In order to show the CT that you hate #Bitcoin why don’t you sell all your BTC to me in return of 1 Doge?
It will dump the hell out of BTC and pump $Doge . Win/Win for all of us!

The beauty of Bitcoin is that everyone is comparing their shitcoins with it, hoping it will flip BTC.
It started with $Eth, now you see people waiting for $Dot, $Ada, $Doge,... to flip Bitcoin.
Kinda like Messi and the rest of the footballers.
@JohnWRichKid Dogecoin will fall without Bitcoin, that’s for sure. But Bitcoin doesn’t need anyone so stop pretending they need each other😂
